main_text.l: veré est Agnus Dei, tribuitur: qua de re exstant vulgati
ver-sus, plenissimi impietatis: Lib.1. Ceremoniarum Curia Roma-
Balsamus, & munda cera, cum chrismatis unda,
Conficiunt agnum, quod manus do tibi magnum
Fonte velut natum, per mystica sanctificatum.
Peccatum frangit, ut Christi sanguis, & angit,
Munera fert dignis, virtutem destruit ignis,
Portatus mundé, de fluctibus eripit undæ.

l.i: Scribitur autē, Urbanum v. Pontificem misisse cum his
versibus tres Agnos Dei ad Imperatorem Græcorum.
⌣Asini palmis coronati circumvectatio.
Altaria, in quibus celebrentur Missæ & sacrificia fiant.
Acolyti vel rectius Acoluthi. ⌣Ave⌣Maria.
Albæ & catera vestes lineæ chorales.
Aqua benedicta seu consecrata. ⌣Aspersorium.
Ablutio pedum in die cœnæ Domini, pridie Parasceves.
Ablutio altarium. Abstinentia a carnibus diebus vetitis.
Balneæ animarum, quæ animarum in purgatorio recrean-
darum causa pauperibus calefiunt. Benedictiones placentarum.
Consecrationes imaginum & sepulcrorum.
Campanarum baptisationes adhibitis patrimis seu suscepto-
Ciborum discrimina & delectus.
Consecratio & unctio sacerdotum & sacrificulorum.
Chrisma seu unctio infantium in Baptismo & adultorum
in confirmatione.
Casula: candelabra: cerei consecrati & lucernæ.
Ciborium seu repositorium, vel theca, in qua asservatur deus
Maozim seu deus panaceus, qui circugestatur in pōpa Persica.
Campanella, Cymbala, nolæ & crepitacula.
Cineres consecrati & cinerum consecratorum susceptio.
Confessio auricularis quæ Sacerdoti fit in aurem.

page.notes: The faint "337" at the top right appears handwritten, so it is left out. "Fonte" in the verse is partly obscured and read as uncertain; it is not marked in the text, but the reading "Fo nte" is doubtful. The "(rib." beside the list line is unclear and is marked [?]. The symbol "⌣" before some list entries is an unclear mark and is copied as a sign. The verse line "Prægnans" shows a gap in the scan. Long s has been normalised to s. No printed error is corrected.
